title: Harpd Product Discovery Index
description: Non-sponsored coverage dataset: software, AI and developer products discovered from public launch and directory sources and enriched from each product's own homepage. Coverage, not quality — it records what exists and what can be verified, never a rating.
attribution: Harpd (https://harpd.com). Per-product text is the product's own published title/description, retrieved from its homepage.
disclosure: This index is independent of Harpd Rank Points. Inclusion requires no payment and confers no placement. It is a coverage dataset, not an evaluation, ranking, review or endorsement.

fields.id: Stable slug; also the /discovery/{id}/ URL segment.
fields.name: Product display name, taken from og:site_name, title or the harvest record — never rewritten.
fields.domain: Registrable domain of the product homepage.
fields.category: One of the 28 Harpd board categories, assigned by keyword evidence.
fields.category_confidence: 0–1 bounded function of matched keyword weight. NOT a probability.
fields.classification_evidence: Exact tokens that produced the category assignment (auditable).
fields.description: Verbatim meta description from the product's own homepage, truncated to 500 chars.
fields.github_url: First GitHub repository linked from the homepage. Empty when none is linked.
fields.discovered_from: Public source where Harpd first observed the product.
fields.completeness: 0–1 weighted sum of observable fields. Drives page eligibility only.
fields.on_rank_board: True when the product already has a canonical Harpd Rank profile.
fields.observed_at: ISO timestamp of the homepage fetch that produced this record.
